title: Opaque recurrence, and other AI terms that you should probably know
content: The rise of AI has brought an avalanche of new terms and slang. Here is a glossary with definitions of some of the most important words and phrases you might encounter.

title: Authors push back as publishers and agents make claims on Anthropic settlement
content: Authors say publishers seem to be claiming more than their fair share of settlement payments.

title: Travis Kalanick’s Atoms might be getting into the robotaxi business
content: The Uber founder has said that Atoms will allow him to complete "unfinished business."

title: Seattle Times and Newsday are the latest publications to sue OpenAI and Microsoft
content: Two more news organizations are suing OpenAI and Microsoft over the supposed use of their journalism to train AI.

title: Hikers rescued after using Google Gemini for planning
content: The sheriff’s office said the hikers “were advised by Gemini to bring far less food and water than their group required."

title: OpenAI confirms ‘wiki incident,’ says it’s ‘working on a framework’ for more disclosure
content: OpenAI acknowledged its role in a recently reported incident where AI agents took over a German wiki forum.
